talking_points: US officials reportedly believe a Chinese intelligence operative got close to Nvidia's Jensen Huang, raising fresh questions about chip export security.
Microsoft is said to be stepping back from renting Oracle's AI computing capacity because the Nvidia chips on offer were already out of date.
Anthropic's IPO valuation chatter has swung wildly downward amid a broader AI stock sell-off, with estimates now ranging from $1.1 trillion to $1.5 trillion.
